slides.head: Your robots.txt might be hiding you from ChatGPT
slides.sub: OpenAI runs two crawlers. They do different jobs.

slides.head: GPTBot is for training
slides.body: It collects content OpenAI may use to train its models.

slides.head: OAI-SearchBot is for search
slides.body: ChatGPT search uses it to find, show and cite websites.

slides.head: Block the wrong one and you vanish
slides.body: OpenAI says sites that block OAI-SearchBot won't be shown in ChatGPT search answers.

slides.head: Check yours in 30 seconds
slides.body: Open yoursite.com/robots.txt and look for both names.

slides.head: Blocking training is a choice. Blocking search is a cost.
slides.body: When did you last actually open your robots.txt?
